The '''PowerLock 2500''' was a console locking mechanism manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. Attached directly to the [[Power coupling/Legends|power coupling]] feeding the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] consoles, the lock cut the power to the controls until the proper combination was entered, or a [[Keycard/Legends|keycard]] was used.<ref name="PSG" />
